jsonRequestPointerArray.description: Field-level least-privilege allowlist into the Host request document: query values are string arrays, params are strings, headers use lowercase canonical names, and body is typed JSON. The document root is forbidden.

jsonResponsePointerArray.description: Field-level least-privilege allowlist into the Host response document: exact status, lowercase canonical headers, or typed JSON body. The document root is forbidden.

requestSchema.description: Required for unsafe HTTP request documents. Optional compatibility metadata for opaque non-HTTP payloads; the Host does not validate stream chunks against it.

responseSchema.description: Required for structured HTTP responses. Optional compatibility metadata for opaque non-HTTP payloads; the Host does not validate stream chunks against it.

queue.description: Queue lane for this job. Omit or use "default" for ordinary work; "ai" is the site low-concurrency lane for slow model calls. Other Host queues are not open to extensions.

enabledBySetting.description: Optional boolean setting key on the same extension. When set, the contribution is only effective when that setting resolves truthy (stored value or schema default).

label.description: Plugin-owned public display name injected into Host auth catalog. Core must not hard-code vendor brands.

icon.description: Optional Iconify/Nuxt Icon name declared by the plugin (for example i-tabler-brand-github).
